title: Repeat-Charge Tenure Courtesy: Community Rules & Site Care Desk Guidance with Worked Cases
content:
A repeat-charge tenure courtesy settles the repeat-violation charge under Community Rules & Site Care from the capped sum: the sum of every amount making up the charge once any tenure limit on it has been applied. Tenure is counted in whole calendar months from the move-in date on the Home-Site Lease to the handling date, and returned payments are counted on the Home-Site Lease ledger within the 12 calendar months ending on the handling date.

1. With at least 120 months of tenure and no returned payment, the charge is half the capped sum, rounded down to the whole dollar.
2. When the first condition does not hold but the resident has at least 60 months of tenure and at most one returned payment, the charge is 0.75 times the capped sum, rounded up to the whole dollar.
3. Otherwise the charge is the capped sum.

## Combinations

| Tenure (whole calendar months) | Returned payments in the 12 months | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| 120 or more | none | 1 |
| 120 or more | one | 2 |
| 120 or more | two or more | 3 |
| 60 to 119 | none or one | 2 |
| 60 to 119 | two or more | 3 |
| fewer than 60 | any | 3 |

## Worked cases (hypothetical capped sums)

| Capped sum | Rule 1 | Rule 2 | Rule 3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| $100.00 | $50.00 | $75.00 | $100.00 |
| $62.50 | $31.25, rounded down to $31.00 | $46.875, rounded up to $47.00 | $62.50 |
| $140.00 | $70.00 | $105.00 | $140.00 |
